answer_1.quote: We present a framework for training a supporter model ... the supporter model aims to generate supporter responses ... evaluated through conversations with the seeker simulator ...
answer_1.outputs: Supporter utterances (dialogue turns) that provide emotional support

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated responses using BERT-Score, correlation of length, cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, sentiment strength (EmoLlama-Chat-7B), and value alignment metrics ...

answer_3.quote: GPT-4o-mini is used as the assessment model for ES‑Skills and ES‑Value, employing pairwise comparisons and rating scales ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation ... 16 evaluators ... asked 'Which response is more natural for the seeker?' ... also expert therapists rated dialogues on validation, positive aspects, and overall support quality.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compared generated seeker responses to human references and answered which was more natural; therapists rated dialogues on multiple support criteria.
